overview: The Council addressed neighborhood safety complaints in South Medford Square and approved a three-year collective bargaining agreement for Department of Public Works employees.

items.title: South Medford Square Traffic and Safety Concerns
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting immediate mayoral action on previously authorized bollards and curb cuts in South Medford Square, while referring broader concerns regarding restaurant-related traffic and enforcement to the Transportation Subcommittee. Residents testified that previously approved safety measures have languished for nearly a year while sidewalk parking and heavy traffic from local businesses have created dangerous conditions for pedestrians.

items.title: DPW Collective Bargaining Agreement and Funding
items.summary: Approved a three-year contract for Department of Public Works employees featuring staggered pay raises through 2018 and authorized the transfer of $71,126 from negotiated salaries and enterprise fund earnings to cover the initial costs.

items.title: License Commission Reappointment
items.summary: Confirmed the reappointment of Allan Martorana to the Medford License Commission for a term expiring in June 2018.

items.title: Medford Chamber of Commerce Great Debate
items.summary: Received an announcement regarding a public debate for mayoral and council candidates scheduled for October 15 at Chevalier Auditorium.

items.title: High Street CVS Property Sale
items.summary: Resolved to have the Mayor and the Office of Community Development contact CVS management regarding reports that its High Street property is for sale and may close.

items.title: Routine Resolutions and Announcements
items.summary: Held a moment of silence for Angelo Serboni, acknowledged Margaret Weigel’s appointment to the Chevalier Auditorium Commission, and announced upcoming memorial events for Crystal Campbell and Timothy Brennan.

items.title: Public Safety and Administrative Inquiries
items.summary: Requested that the Mayor fill a vacancy on the Logan Airport noise advisory board and asked for status reports on cat control ordinances and the development of the city dog park.
